_comment: Does the request ask to keep every step's output (owner 2026-10-14:`--keep-intermediates` in both CLIs, and request words turn it on too)? Python `knaif.scratch.wants_everything_kept`, Rust `knaif_core::scratch::wants_everything_kept`. A keep verb next to a scope (intermediate files, everything, all the files, every step), in either order within two words for languages that put the verb last. `save` is never a keep verb: it names outputs. A negated English request keeps the default.
